definitions.profit_revenue_earned: Completed appointments this month: the amount recorded at the salon where entered, otherwise the booked price. An estimate, not a payment.
definitions.profit_revenue_earned_recorded: The part of revenue so far that comes from amounts recorded at the salon.
definitions.profit_revenue_upcoming: Pending, confirmed and checked-in appointments from now to month end, at their booked prices.
definitions.profit_no_show_allowance: Assumption: upcoming revenue × the salon's no-show rate over the last 90 days (needs at least 20 finished appointments).
definitions.profit_service_costs: Material cost entered per service, variant and add-on, for done and upcoming appointments. Services without a cost count as 0đ.
definitions.profit_payroll: One total for the team: full-month base pay + commission earned + upcoming commission + bonuses − deductions. Before tax and insurance.
definitions.profit_other_costs: Costs the owner entered: rent, utilities, products, marketing…
definitions.profit_net: Month revenue − service costs − pay − other costs. An estimate before tax.
definitions.profit_month_progress: Days elapsed (including today) ÷ days in the month.
definitions.profit_employer_costs: What the salon pays on top of gross pay (taxes, social insurance, other contributions) as you entered it per person. 0 when not set. Included in pay & commission.
